characters.name: Connect-O-Tron
characters.appearance: Invented gadget: white trapezoid base, orange capsule body with three state lamps, teal cone emitter, glass dome holding an idea light bulb; thick dark-ink outlines, flat fills.
characters.role: Speculative device whose OFF/ON state turns an idea into a connected system.
characters.evidence: ILLUSTRATION.svg composition reference and index.html drawDevice().

characters.name: Sidekick robot
characters.appearance: Small teal boxy robot head with white round eyes, pink-tipped antenna and white body block; same drawing in wide and close-up shots.
characters.role: Delivers the single strong reaction to the gadget.
characters.evidence: ILLUSTRATION.svg composition reference and index.html drawRobot().

displayDescription: A cartoon gadget fires an idea, a robot does a hard double-take, and the cut back reveals the idea wired into a connected system.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, sound effects, narration or subtitles.
limitations: No reviewed preview recipe exists in STYLE.json and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied; the preview demonstrates the catalogue characteristic action (gadget state, reaction cut, altered prop).
Cel animation is approximated with procedural Canvas 2D vector drawing; line boil is a seeded per-vertex jitter stepped at 12 drawings per second and frozen from 2.4 s.
Beam light and glows are flat translucent fills, not physical lighting.
Typography uses locally installed Futura with Trebuchet MS / sans-serif fallback; copy auto-shrinks to fit the bubble if the fallback is wider.
Blender was not used, per instruction.
